This PR closes some holes in the ZHA group entity lifecycle. The PR does the following:

- Move state restore from the BaseZhaEntity to ZhaEntity because groups shouldn't restore state
- Cleans up the entity registry when a group is removed
- re-probes groups when members are added or removed ensuring that we always add or remove entities as needed

## The problem
<!-- 
  Describe the issue you are experiencing here to communicate to the
  maintainers. Tell us what you were trying to do and what happened.
-->
When a ZHA group is created and deleted, creating a new group will result in the new group having the same entity_id as the old (deleted)

Something appears to be recycled in core.entity_registry

I created a group (with two bulbs) called `test` and then deleted it (and restarted HASS). I then created a new group with the same bulbs called `group_zig`. The entity id that appeared was the same as the original: `light.test_zha_group_0x0001`

comments: Hey there @dmulcahey, @adminiuga, mind taking a look at this issue as its been labeled with a integration (`zha`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L450) for? Thanks!

So, I’m not sure what the actual issue you have is? The unique id for the group will be the same because we use the next available identifier. Ex: create group with group Id of 0x0001, then delete it. Next group you create will get 0x0001 as its id so it’s unique id will be the same thing the previous groups was. You’ll never have this happen with multiple existing groups. Our entity ids are provided and not statically set. I’m guessing that something wasn’t cleaned up when the previous group was removed but that said I’m not sure it really matters? you can change this value to be whatever you want it to be... what issue is this actually causing for you? I’ll look to see if there is something that isn’t cleaned up too.

It's not an "issue," but it just doesn't feel like expected behavior. I'm not sure from where the unique ID is derived but assumed unique ID's wouldn't be "recycled." That said, this doesn't sound like it's related to ZHA specifically. Thanks for your attention!

The unique Id is tied directly to the group Id and therefore is recycled and it’s safe because you’ll never have 2 groups with the same group id. That said, I checked and I can clean up the entity registry entries in this case and it would prevent what you’re seeing. I just wanted to ensure that there wasn’t any other issue tied to this and that my understanding of what you were reporting was correct.

What you describe lines up with what I saw when testing different things. 

I don't know what best practice is for components, cleaning up config registry entries on GUI deletion or not. Personally I lean toward cleaning things up but that might be preference more than anything.
I’m going to clean them up, you’ll see a linked pr in the next day or 2

review_comments: I'm on the fence whether we should use `zigpy.exceptions.ZigbeeException` instead of `DeliveryError` here.  DeliverError is raised when the delivery fails (doh) but if usb port is disconnected or `bellows` is restarting it is going to be a different exception and either way any of those exceptions means the  device hasn't received the request.
